observational_status: single-diagnostic LIUQE reconstruction numerical-quality audit; not prospective, causal-analog, controller-in-loop, or calibrated TS/LIUQE synchronization
successful_milestone: Verified source integrity and isolated 108 of 113 extreme kappa>10 cells (95.6%) to near-axis rho<=0.05 across 321 LIUQE frames; the bulk and edge contain 5 and 0 such cells. Found 321 near-zero minor-radius cells and 116 near-axis grid excursions, but their direct cellwise overlap with extreme kappa was not yet measured.
interpretation: Near-axis localization of extreme reconstruction elongation is supported, while a specific zero-radius numerical singularity remains unproven. This is not a measured TCT mechanism, an experimental precursor, or physical equilibrium validation. All convergence flags being true does not validate near-axis geometry.
followup_scope: One bounded contingency audit of kappa>10 vs tiny aminor and grid excursions within the same LIUQE reconstruction; no solver physics, cross-diagnostic alignment or threshold changes.
pb11_fidelity_limits: not_applicable; no p-B11 reaction, recirculation, radiation/electron loss, alpha transport/channeling, boron delivery, direct conversion, rotation/shear, liquid lithium, ignition or net-power evidence
m3dc1_claim_boundary: No native M3D-C1 execution, zero/handoff equivalence, calibrated shot-to-native mapping or controller intervention. Frozen width >+0.020% and Jpk <=+0.10% gates unchanged and not mapped to this LIUQE audit.
